title: Copilot Adoption Activity Catalog
subtitle: A menu of adoption activities with audience and length. Mix and sequencing are tailored to your organization.

activities.name: Excite Day Breakouts (PowerPoint, Excel, Agent Builder, Notebooks, Agents, Mini Prompt-a-thon)
Advanced Webinar or Series
activities.audience: Function teams and power users who completed intro training

activities.name: Copilot Office Hours
activities.size: No limit*; formal topic submission for large groups

activities.name: Lunch-and-Learns, Demo Days and Team Huddles
activities.audience: End users, managers and their teams

activities.name: AI Agents Hackathon
activities.audience: Makers and developers (up to 16 per CSA)

notes: Subsection audience sizes follow the parent activity. *Role-Based Scenario Prioritization Workshop is extrapolated at up to 25 participants based on its small-group format; confirm during planning.
* “No limit” indicates there is no fixed attendance cap. For very large groups, live Q&A may need to be time-boxed or moderated to keep the session manageable.

sections.title: Copilot Webinar or Series: Intro Track
rows: What Copilot is and how it uses your work data; finding Copilot Chat and the app on web, desktop and mobile; first prompts; a "top 10 things to try" checklist
Drafting, summarizing and analysis in Teams, Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint, with hands-on prompts in each app
Anatomy of an effective prompt, the Prompt Gallery, guided exercises and refining results
Teaching tips and prompting guidance so champions can coach peers and lead by example
Why now, fundamentals, hands-on leader workflows, advanced possibilities and next steps
sections.intro: Five foundational sessions for every audience. Run them as single webinars or as a four-week series. All are live, hands-on and recorded.

callout.label: Delivery options
callout.text: a lighter 30-minute modular format works well for pilots, and recurring office hours keep support going between sessions. Role-specific versions of these sessions are covered under BU / Function Training.

sections.title: BU / Function Training
rows: Grounded agent to draft manager-ready performance plans; attrition and risk analysis with Analyst; survey comments to action plan; investigation questions and case summaries; case pre-visit analysis; labor and employment news briefing
Over/short commentary analysis and follow-up drafts; data quality checks and exception reports; contract review for terms, risks and expirations
Weekly sales, inventory and stockout analysis in Excel; recurring report automation; executive weekly summary
Matter tracking and status updates; legislative and compliance monitoring briefs; clause-based drafting and version comparison for attorney review
Repeatable Excel reports with trend and outlier checks; project status, risks and tasks; recurring insight newsletters
Triage missed requests; goal alignment; meeting and trip preparation; meeting notes and follow-ups; morning briefings with draft replies
Weekly performance recap with drivers; insight synthesis from unstructured inputs; work-request intake and prioritization
Process mapping and SOP generation; monthly industry point-of-view briefs; stakeholder alignment; natural-language reporting
Voice-of-customer themes and actions; category health reporting; stakeholder storytelling
sections.intro: Function-specific sessions built around the real workflows of one team. Each opens with a short foundations recap, walks through function use cases with live demos, and closes with next steps. Typical length is 60-90 minutes, and a function leader or champion validates scenarios in advance. The same pattern extends to other teams such as Sales and IT.

sections.title: Advanced Webinar or Series
rows: Function teams who completed BU / Function Training
Deeper versions of each function's use cases: agents grounded in team data, Analyst, and multi-step recurring reporting
15 min foundations reminder, 25 min app examples, 35 min department demos using connected enterprise systems, 15 min Q&A
Research, Analysis and Content Power Techniques
Researcher and Analyst deep dive, multi-step Excel analysis, turning source documents into decks
Grounding on a body of files and reusable prompt packs for weekly and monthly reporting
sections.intro: For users who have completed intro training. Advanced agent and Cowork content is covered by the Agent Builder, Copilot Studio and Cowork sessions in the catalog above.
notes: Durations and audiences are typical and are confirmed during planning.
